newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 12.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 12.

text.p: The following stories were reported on Lithuania's M1 Plus radio at noon on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- Lithuanian foreign minister Algirdas Saudargas continues meeting with other Nordic and Baltic foreign ministers to discuss European integration and immigration issues.
-- Lithuanian culture minister Saulius Shaltenis to travel to Latvia on an official visit.
-- President Algirdas Brazauskas met with officials from the national security department.
